reviews.author: anirudh priyadarshi srikoo
reviews.text:
Outstanding holistic care with Dr. Rakhi Damaraju!
Finding a specialist who genuinely connects the dots between dental, hair, and skin health is rare, but Dr. Rakhi Damaraju at Conquer Hospitals is exceptional. Rather than treating issues in isolation, she evaluates overall wellness and underlying root causes to build a seamless, personalized treatment plan.
Her dual expertise in oral/maxillofacial care and hair restoration—alongside the hospital’s integrated dermatology unit—makes the entire process smooth and comforting. She takes time to explain every detail, answers questions patiently, and ensures procedures are completely stress-free. Conquer Hospitals is spotless, highly professional, and easily the top choice in Guntur for comprehensive cosmetic and restorative care.
